description: This file defines the PersistentStreamProvider class in the Orleans streaming framework, including its commands, lifecycle management, stream creation, and command execution mechanisms.

classes.name: PersistentStreamProvider
classes.description: A persistent stream provider that uses an adapter for persistence, managing streams, lifecycle, and command execution within Orleans.

methods.name: PersistentStreamProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream provider with necessary dependencies and configuration options.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the provider, creates adapter, and sets up subscription manager based on options.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the provider by initializing pulling agents if applicable and transitioning state.

methods.name: GetStreamSubscriptionManager
methods.description: Returns the stream subscription manager used by this provider.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the provider and stops any running pulling agents.

methods.name: GetStream
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a stream with the specified stream ID.

methods.name: GetProducerInterface
methods.description: Returns the producer interface for a given stream if the provider is writable.

methods.name: GetConsumerInterface
methods.description: Returns the consumer interface for a given stream.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes control commands related to adapter, factory, or pulling agents.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the provider to lifecycle events.
